get.description: List available models in OpenAI format

context.description: Context from a previous response to continue generation.

keep_alive.description: How long to keep the model loaded (e.g., "5m", "-1" for forever).

prompt.description: The prompt to generate a response for.

system.description: Optional system prompt to override the model's default.

template.description: Optional template to use for generation.

ModelOptions.description:
Model generation options for native Ollama API.

Controls model behavior including sampling parameters, context window,
and hardware utilization.

num_gpu.description: Number of GPU layers to offload (-1 for all).

num_thread.description: Number of CPU threads to use.

keep_alive.description: How long to keep the model loaded.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: A chat message in the native Ollama format.

images.description: Optional images for multimodal models (base64 encoded).

role.description: The role of the message author (system, user, assistant).

keep_alive.description: How long to keep the model loaded.

ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo
ModelInfo.description: A model in the list response.

RunningModel.title: RunningModel
RunningModel.description: A running model in the `/api/ps` response.

expires_at.description: When the model will be unloaded.

OpenAIMessage.title: OpenAIMessage
OpenAIMessage.description: A chat message in the OpenAI format.

role.description: The role of the message author.

OpenAIEmbeddingData.title: OpenAIEmbeddingData
OpenAIEmbeddingData.description: An embedding object in the response.

OpenAIModel.title: OpenAIModel
OpenAIModel.description: A model in the OpenAI-compatible list.

owned_by.description: Owner of the model (always "library" for Ollama).

OpenAIChatCompletionChoice.title: OpenAIChatCompletionChoice
OpenAIChatCompletionChoice.description: A choice in the chat completion response.

OpenAIDelta.title: OpenAIDelta
OpenAIDelta.description: Delta content in OpenAI streaming format.

OpenAIStreamChoice.title: OpenAIStreamChoice
OpenAIStreamChoice.description: A choice in the streaming response.

finish_reason.description: Why the model stopped generating (final chunk only).

OpenAIChatStreamChunk.title: OpenAIChatStreamChunk
OpenAIChatStreamChunk.description: A streaming chunk from the `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint.

OpenAICompletionChoice.title: OpenAICompletionChoice
OpenAICompletionChoice.description: A choice in the completion response.

OpenAICompletionStreamChunk.title: OpenAICompletionStreamChunk
OpenAICompletionStreamChunk.description: A streaming chunk from the `/v1/completions` endpoint.

choices.description: Text choices; `finish_reason` is set on the final chunk only.

StreamErrorLine.title: StreamErrorLine
StreamErrorLine.description:
A mid-stream error line, such as `{"error": "model not found"}`.

Ollama can send it inside a stream whose status is still 200, so every
native NDJSON item type carries it as a variant.

GenerateStreamChunk.title: GenerateStreamChunk
GenerateStreamChunk.description: A streaming chunk from the `/api/generate` endpoint.

context.description: Context for continuing generation (final chunk only).

eval_count.description: Number of tokens generated (final chunk only).

prompt_eval_count.description: Number of tokens in the prompt (final chunk only).

total_duration.description: Total time in nanoseconds (final chunk only).

GenerateStreamItem.title: GenerateStreamItem
GenerateStreamItem.description: One NDJSON line from the streaming `/api/generate` endpoint.

anyOf.description: A generated text chunk; the final one has `done: true` and statistics.

GenerateCompletion.title: GenerateCompletion
GenerateCompletion.description:
Buffered reply from the `/api/generate` endpoint, returned when `stream`
is false.

Not named `GenerateResponse`: that is the generated success enum of the
`Generate` endpoint.

eval_duration.description: Time spent generating tokens in nanoseconds.

load_duration.description: Time spent loading the model in nanoseconds.

prompt_eval_count.description: Number of tokens in the prompt.

prompt_eval_duration.description: Time spent evaluating the prompt in nanoseconds.

ChatStreamChunk.title: ChatStreamChunk
ChatStreamChunk.description: A streaming chunk from the `/api/chat` endpoint.

eval_count.description: Number of tokens generated (final chunk only).

prompt_eval_count.description: Number of tokens in the prompt (final chunk only).

total_duration.description: Total time in nanoseconds (final chunk only).

ChatStreamItem.title: ChatStreamItem
ChatStreamItem.description: One NDJSON line from the streaming `/api/chat` endpoint.

anyOf.description: A message chunk; the final one has `done: true` and statistics.

ChatCompletion.title: ChatCompletion
ChatCompletion.description:
Buffered reply from the `/api/chat` endpoint, returned when `stream` is
false.

Not named `ChatResponse`: that is the generated success enum of the `Chat`
endpoint.

eval_duration.description: Time spent generating tokens in nanoseconds.

load_duration.description: Time spent loading the model in nanoseconds.

prompt_eval_count.description: Number of tokens in the prompt.

prompt_eval_duration.description: Time spent evaluating the prompt in nanoseconds.

PullModelProgress.title: PullModelProgress
PullModelProgress.description:
Progress line from a streaming model pull or push. The last line is
`{"status": "success"}`.

PullModelStreamItem.title: PullModelStreamItem
PullModelStreamItem.description: One NDJSON line from a streaming `/api/pull` or `/api/push`.

CreateModelProgress.title: CreateModelProgress
CreateModelProgress.description:
Progress line from a streaming model creation. The last line is
`{"status": "success"}`.

CreateModelStreamItem.title: CreateModelStreamItem
CreateModelStreamItem.description: One NDJSON line from a streaming `/api/create`.

StatusResponse.title: StatusResponse
StatusResponse.description:
Buffered reply from `/api/pull`, `/api/push`, or `/api/create`, returned
when `stream` is false.

status.description: The final status, `success` when the operation completed.
